description: This file defines a plugin class for the Revive Adserver, specifically an invocation tag plugin for generating JavaScript tags with configurable options and code generation logic.

classes.name: Plugins_InvocationTags_OxInvocationTags_adjs
classes.description: A plugin class for generating invocation tags in Revive Adserver, providing options and code generation for JavaScript tags.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the plugin, translated as 'Javascript Tag'.

methods.name: getNameEN
methods.description: Returns the English name of the plugin, 'Javascript Tag'.

methods.name: isAllowed
methods.description: Checks if the plugin is allowed by calling the parent method.

methods.name: getOrder
methods.description: Returns the order of the plugin, fixed at 1.

methods.name: getOptionsList
methods.description: Returns a list of configurable options for the plugin, excluding 'cacheBuster' if present.

methods.name: generateInvocationCode
methods.description: Generates the JavaScript invocation code with configurable parameters and noscript fallback.

methods.name: setInvocation
methods.description: Sets the invocation object and enables charset detection.
